source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 3 May 1939, p. 9 ("Derry Rural Council")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations from the Belfast Telegraph (3 May 1939, p. 9); Lough Enagh result from the Belfast Telegraph (3 June 1939, p. 9). Read on the page image (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Liberties, Lower—Mr. J. Hatrick'.

note: Triennial election, polled Friday 2 June 1939. Nominations were taken on 2 May. There was a contest only in Lough Enagh; the other twelve divisions were uncontested. Co. Londonderry polled Friday 2 June 1939: 'Polling in the Enagh Lough Division ... took place yesterday' (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1939, p. 8). Re-filed from 1939-05-31, a provisional date (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 3 May 1939, p. 9 (council-audit, Nov 2026): Mr. J. Hatrick as printed (was Hetrick, an OCR misread; the 1946 return prints Joshua Hatrick).
